name: Continental Petroleums Limited
about: Continental Petroleums Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of lubricating oils, greases, specialty oils, SBP-solvents, transformer oils, fuels, and other products for automotive and industrial applications in India. The company provides Common Treatment and Disposal/Incineration Facility (CTDF) services. It also offers EPC projects in power and solar industry. It markets its products under the CONTOL brand name. The company also exports its products. Continental Petroleums Limited was incorporated in 1986 and is headquartered in Jaipur, India.
